headline: Trade uncertainty with the US is drawing Mexico and Europe closer: Hansen
summary: EU Agriculture Commissioner Christophe Hansen expects Mexico to clear the final hurdle for a new trade pact with the EU to take effect before year-end. He cited trade uncertainty with the United States.
why: Trade agreements between the EU and Mexico affect tariffs and market access for agriculture and manufacturing, and Mexico is a major trading partner for both the US and Europe.
original_headline: La incertidumbre comercial con EU está acercando más a México y a Europa: Hansen
